title: Local-group public-person expander pass 1

provenance.method: public-person expansion from existing local-group graph

data.research_question: Which publicly identifiable people can be expanded from already-merged local-group nodes while preserving direct versus inferred relationship status?
data.method: Start from already-merged local-group organization records; inspect current/recent public sources and older sources where they preserve dated roles; dedupe against existing canonical people; materialize only mature person and person-org edges; leave unresolved identities unpromoted.
classification_rules: A directly stated public organizational role may be materialized as an explicit relation.
Historical role evidence remains dated/historical when current role is not established.
Do not merge people from name similarity alone.
Already-canonical people are reused/skipped rather than duplicated.
Inferred relations remain distinguishable from direct observations.

findings.notes: Maxine Spencer and Alexandria Danner are directly identified in March 2026 public reporting as Trans Aid Nashville co-founders; Spencer is independently corroborated by a 2025 CFMT event page.
Chappy Hull fills a gap alongside already-canonical Kathryn Edwards and Olive Scibelli; 2024 public reporting directly identifies him as a DRKMTTR owner/co-manager.
Sarah Stout is retained as a historical 2020 volunteer organizer with current status unresolved.
Jonathan Bowerstock and Jeremy Peraza were already canonical from area-code shard-C pass 20; first-name-only public volunteer references were not promoted into ambiguous identities.
Current organization/public-account surfaces were checked but no sufficiently stable named public organizational actor matured in this bounded pass.
